blockers.wanted: per-shard pitch variety from the fragment size (value)
blockers.tried: voices map size = f(1 - $value): shatter values are a power law 0.01..1, so nearly every piece got the same size and the same pitch (pitch by tenth stayed constant)
blockers.workaround: size from $rand; $value only for level (gain 0.35 + 0.65 sqrt(value))

blockers.wanted: replace a filter named crack by a gain named crack in one batch
blockers.tried: upsert plus a delete op for the same name in the same batch: error 'crack is a filter; delete it first'; the delete did not help, and a retry with the delete failed 'no node named crack' because an earlier attempt had already applied it
blockers.workaround: used a new name and a separate delete

blockers.wanted: a snap knob that raises crest
blockers.tried: crack level knob with claim crest: sweep 21.01 -> 20.97 dB, since peak is normalised and set by the first voice; no hint why
blockers.workaround: renamed it grit with claim flatness (passes, but only a weak move 0.30 -> 0.38)

blockers.wanted: small bright shards (size < 0.039 m for 3 mm glass) and a hit at sample 0
blockers.tried: modal size minimum errored (helpful text, min size not in describe_op); output fade_in 0 fails silent_edges for a hit at t=0, fade_in 1 ms cut the hit by 3 dB and lowered peak_db target to -5.9
blockers.workaround: clamped size with max(0.041, ...), moved shatter at to 4 ms, default 2 ms fade

wishlist: a glass-specific shard patch / material 'glass_thin' in shatter -> voices as one node, with per-fragment pitch from size
silent_edges that accepts a hit at sample 0 with fade_in 0
measure for onset count split into crack and shards, and a visible 'shard onsets' number in verify expect
what_worked: shatter -> voices of a small modal gave the cascade (18 detected onsets, thinning out) in one try
macro param map into the voices patch, and the sweep at creation caught a size range error at once
listen spectrogram and onset table made the thinning-out and centroid (5.2 k) easy to read
